title: Keep agent skills required in doctor
selected_option: Keep configured Jig Codex skills as a required global doctor check.
rationale: The repo config declares agent tooling as required setup, and the existing adoption docs state agent doctor exits nonzero until required setup is complete. The current local failure is a user-level Codex marketplace registration issue, not a product defect in this change.
alternatives: Make agent skills optional in global doctor.
Add a new config switch for doctor-required agent tooling.

title: Document receipt privacy redaction
selected_option: Preserve the receipt identity and unaffected execution metadata while redacting only the accidentally captured private fixture text.
rationale: Receipt receipt_01KZMM3FY75Z9440KG56GAKGWX captured a private fixture identifier in its diagnostic preview. The current-tree privacy migration retains its ID, status, timestamps, digests, and all unrelated fields; this decision records provenance without repeating the removed text.
alternatives: Restore the private fixture text and preserve byte-for-byte history.
Delete the affected receipt instead of preserving its non-sensitive evidence.
